transport: USB MIDI SysEx; no host audio device
input: Dry guitar ADC, before NAM/effects. Average groups of four 48 kHz Q31 input samples after shifting to Q15; two samples per audio callback. Playback sample rate remains 48 kHz.
capture_behavior: Explicit muted-only start. Stops automatically at 2048 samples; completed snapshot immutable until next start. Stop/reset clears count; restart defaults off. Enabling plug listening during collection cancels it.

operations.1: start a new capture, page must be 0

nonce: 1..16383 echoed; generation must match across pages
reply: prefix F0 43 58 70 04 02 4E 55 01, pack7(280 raw bytes), F7; exactly330 bytes

raw_layout.7: status0 success,1 capture incomplete,3 cannot start while listening
raw_layout.20: 128 signed int16 LE samples for ready read; otherwise zero

mutation_scope: Private RAM capture only; no preset/model/flash/clock/reset/output-enable writes
app: Chromatic YIN with longer-period interpolation, A430..450Hz reference, silence/noise rejection. Tune mutes the plug; closing leaves it muted for an explicit Listen on plug click.
limits: Offline synthetic pitch/ARM tests do not establish real-guitar accuracy or hardware timing. Boxcar decimation is not a general recording-quality anti-alias filter.
